paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 49a: he disagrees with Rav Adda bar Minyumi, and they asked Ravina about it.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Davidson Chullin 49a paragraph has untitled Huna Mar son of Rav Idi and Rav Adda bar Minyumi giving different rulings, followed by a question to Ravina. The full father title and querying direction are supported; the text is not expanded to identify which individuals asked, and no legal ruling is imported.
